title: 1887: Make selected item(s) stand out more

comments_data.body: Ooh, that's good. Can you reduce the pause between the pulses?  (there is a brief period when no highlight (pulse) is shown).

issues.title: Make selected item(s) stand out more
issues.body:
When an item is selected, we render it in a circular icon, and provide a white border.

This isn't clear enough to the analysts that saw it today.

Could we experiment with a solid black border?

comments.body:
I've made a PR #1887 to make a slight improvement to this, but this is much better:
https://github.com/mapshakers/leaflet-icon-pulse

![pulse](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/192344853-97330b49-9ef5-4bde-b80d-ee7028d76420.gif)

Note: _hopefully_ we'll configure the pulsing icon to only show the pulse - not the central icon.

I _guess_ we'll modify `PlanningForce` to have two markers if the asset is selected.  If it is selected, we'll display the normal `AssetIcon` plus a pulse icon.

Hmm, I've just looked at the source code for `leaflet-icon-pulse`.  It looks like it's just a css effect, so maybe we don't need the plugin - we just copy/apply the CSS via a `selected` class.
